content: You call me unworthy of that crown, but who else but me could possibly lead the Sarkaz on a path to our survival?!

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]Qui'lon brought our people on a wandering path of no return, and Yliš's retreat into hiding would only make us weak.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Qui'lon brought our people on a wandering path of no return, and Yliš's retreat into hiding would only make us weak.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]Even that pair of siblings, all they did was push Sarkaz into futile conflict, and let the crown slip into outblood hands!
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Even that pair of siblings, all they did was push Sarkaz into futile conflict, and let the crown slip into outblood hands!

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]The Sarkaz... need a true King, an eternal King.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: The Sarkaz... need a true King, an eternal King.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]I will reach our starting point, and together with the sins of Qui'sartuštaj and his blood, purge all of the Sarkaz's sins!
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: I will reach our starting point, and together with the sins of Qui'sartuštaj and his blood, purge all of the Sarkaz's sins!

raw: [Subtitle(text="Sin.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Sin.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The word intensifies the ire in Shining.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The word intensifies the ire in Shining.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Her father and brother were both possessed by this undying monster—while she and her mother lived under the madness of his shadow.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Her father and brother were both possessed by this undying monster—while she and her mother lived under the madness of his shadow.

raw: [Subtitle(text="To let him live, to kill him—both are afflicted with the curse.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: To let him live, to kill him—both are afflicted with the curse.

raw: [Subtitle(text="She has no path to go.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: She has no path to go.

raw: [Subtitle(text="She has nowhere to retreat.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: She has nowhere to retreat.

raw: [Subtitle(text="But there is no way she can stay here as is.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: But there is no way she can stay here as is.

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: ...Ugh!

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: You... made your move.

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Very good... Qui'saršinnag...

speaker: Shining
content: ...I'll kill you.

speaker: Shining
content: And then...

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Kill yourself?

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]Is this what you call severing the bloodline's curse?
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Is this what you call severing the bloodline's curse?

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: The same stupidity I see.

raw: Qui'sartuštaj grips Shining's sword with hand.
content: Qui'sartuštaj grips Shining's sword with hand.

raw: Blood trickles down the pure white blade and stains her hand.
content: Blood trickles down the pure white blade and stains her hand.

raw: A shudder rises from the depths of her soul.
content: A shudder rises from the depths of her soul.

speaker: Shining
content: —Ugh!

raw: An overwhelming force flings Shining onto a crystal tree.
content: An overwhelming force flings Shining onto a crystal tree.

raw: The sharp black branches pierce through her abdomen.
content: The sharp black branches pierce through her abdomen.

raw: Fresh blood gushes down, and converges with Qui'sartuštaj's blood.
content: Fresh blood gushes down, and converges with Qui'sartuštaj's blood.

raw: The ancient tree long crystallized into Originium bursts a sudden pure white glow.
content: The ancient tree long crystallized into Originium bursts a sudden pure white glow.

raw: In just a moment, countless little moons rise to the top of the tree.
content: In just a moment, countless little moons rise to the top of the tree.
Every Confessarius begins to sing—

raw: [Subtitle(text="The myriad souls lie prostrate.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The myriad souls lie prostrate.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Howling knocks on the door from beneath, tangible usurps the intangible.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Howling knocks on the door from beneath, tangible usurps the intangible.

raw: [Subtitle(text="The Black Crown imprisoned, the offender perpetually innocent.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: The Black Crown imprisoned, the offender perpetually innocent.

raw: [Subtitle(text="Because kings are born before immortality.", x=300, y=370, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text: Because kings are born before immortality.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]Look, even injuries as grievous as this will not infect you—this is the power of the blood you resist.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Look, even injuries as grievous as this will not infect you—this is the power of the blood you resist.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]Qui'saršinnag... I have been patient enough with you.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Qui'saršinnag... I have been patient enough with you.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]But you stay stubborn, unwilling to accept all that belongs to you—your duty, power, glory.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: But you stay stubborn, unwilling to accept all that belongs to you—your duty, power, glory.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]It's alright, just be good and stay aside, while I... complete the ceremony myself.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: It's alright, just be good and stay aside, while I... complete the ceremony myself.

raw: A crown woven of thorns appears in his hand.
content: A crown woven of thorns appears in his hand.

raw: Moonlight shines onto the crown as it illuminates the crystal tree at the end of the steps.
content: Moonlight shines onto the crown as it illuminates the crystal tree at the end of the steps.

raw: In that spot lies a stone bed lined with dead branches, and a curled up figure Shining knows too well atop it.
content: In that spot lies a stone bed lined with dead branches, and a curled up figure Shining knows too well atop it.

speaker: Shining
content: Liz...

speaker: Shining
content: ...Wake up.

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Don't bother.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]Her consciousness is not where you think it to be.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Her consciousness is not where you think it to be.

speaker: Shining
content: She's inside the crown.

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Correct.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]I promised you that I would mend her soul.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: I promised you that I would mend her soul.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]You need only wear the complete crown, and you can be together forever.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: You need only wear the complete crown, and you can be together forever.

speaker: Shining
content: Together forever... in your cage?
Shining shuts her eyes.

raw: She strains to imagine... the time she spent together with Liz.
content: She strains to imagine... the time she spent together with Liz.

raw: They run in the woods, hand in hand.
content: They run in the woods, hand in hand.

raw: They cross the ice-cold creek together.
content: They cross the ice-cold creek together.

raw: With Liz worn out on her back, she walks the road home.
content: With Liz worn out on her back, she walks the road home.

raw: Liz makes a small flower wreath and places it on Shining's head.
content: Liz makes a small flower wreath and places it on Shining's head.

raw: A small blue fowlbeast follows them the whole time, chirping a cheery tune over their heads.
content: A small blue fowlbeast follows them the whole time, chirping a cheery tune over their heads.

raw: It hovers, searches—and lands next to the sleeping white demon.
content: It hovers, searches—and lands next to the sleeping white demon.

raw: It does not know why Liz is sleeping, and anxiously pecks at her cheek with its little beak.
content: It does not know why Liz is sleeping, and anxiously pecks at her cheek with its little beak.

raw: Until a black arrow pierces it.
content: Until a black arrow pierces it.

raw: The fowlbeast vanishes, leaving only a blue feather that lands on Shining's shoulder.
content: The fowlbeast vanishes, leaving only a blue feather that lands on Shining's shoulder.

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Enough.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]You know very well those are not her dreams.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: You know very well those are not her dreams.

speaker: Shining
content: Even if those memories were fabricated...

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]They are fabricated, so why not accept your own power, and reshape her memory once more?
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: They are fabricated, so why not accept your own power, and reshape her memory once more?

speaker: Shining
content: Liz... is Liz.

raw: [name="Shining"]She should be free. I will never shape her soul as I please ever again.
speaker: Shining
content: She should be free. I will never shape her soul as I please ever again.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]Wishful thinking... Qui'saršinnag, my fragile child indulging in fantasy. You are that blue fowlbeast, thirsting for freedom, yet imprisoning yourself.
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: Wishful thinking... Qui'saršinnag, my fragile child indulging in fantasy. You are that blue fowlbeast, thirsting for freedom, yet imprisoning yourself.

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]I prepared everything for you, a perfect body, an ancient power, all you needed is to accept—
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: I prepared everything for you, a perfect body, an ancient power, all you needed is to accept—

raw: [name="Qui'sartuštaj"]But you betrayed me, you abandoned everything that belongs to you, and then? What did you gain?
speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: But you betrayed me, you abandoned everything that belongs to you, and then? What did you gain?

speaker: Qui'sartuštaj
content: You sorely disappoint me.

speaker: Shining
content: ...A new life.

raw: [name="Shining"]I was reborn into a new life after leaving you.
speaker: Shining
content: I was reborn into a new life after leaving you.

raw: [name="Shining"]Not as the Confessarius Qui'saršinnag, nor a puppet of my bloodline...
speaker: Shining
content: Not as the Confessarius Qui'saršinnag, nor a puppet of my bloodline...

speaker: Shining
content: But as Shining...

speaker: Shining
content: ...As a member of the Followers.
Blue feathers prick her wounds.

raw: The slightest of stings momentarily rouses her from her bloodline-induced paralysis.
content: The slightest of stings momentarily rouses her from her bloodline-induced paralysis.

speaker: Shining
content: Come.

speaker: Shining
content: Now... is the time.

speaker: Shining
content: Find me. Find this tree.

speaker: Shining
content: If it were you...

speaker: Shining
content: ...You would certainly make it.

raw: An opening pierces through the crimson clouds.
content: An opening pierces through the crimson clouds.
The sunlight pours down—

raw: Everything around her becomes increasingly brighter.
content: Everything around her becomes increasingly brighter.

speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: That's—

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]It doesn't matter what it is, just hold it back!
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: It doesn't matter what it is, just hold it back!

raw: [name="Confessarius Guard"]The ceremony has already begun, we can't let—Ugh! We can't stop it!
speaker: Confessarius Guard
content: The ceremony has already begun, we can't let—Ugh! We can't stop it!

[ImageTween(xFrom=0, yFrom=170, xTo=0, yTo=70, xScaleFrom=1.8, yScaleFrom=1.8, xScaleTo=1.8, yScaleTo=1.8, duration=20, block=false)]

content: Light.

raw: Light and fog fills the air.
content: Light and fog fills the air.

raw: The sun descends from the sky to repel the clammy moonlight.
content: The sun descends from the sky to repel the clammy moonlight.

raw: [name="Margaret"]Sorry, the storm was too intense, so I took some time to locate you—
speaker: Margaret
content: Sorry, the storm was too intense, so I took some time to locate you—

speaker: Margaret
content: Are you alright?

speaker: Margaret
content: Do you need a hand... Shining?

speaker: Shining
content: ...I'm fine.

speaker: Shining
content: But we have to save... Liz.

speaker: Shining
content: And... stop Qui'sartuštaj.

speaker: Shining
content: Lend me your strength—

raw: [name="Shining"]And dispel the darkness before my eyes.
speaker: Shining
content: And dispel the darkness before my eyes.

speaker: Margaret
content: Of course.

speaker: Margaret
content: Let's go together.

raw: [name="Margaret"]The road ahead of us... I'll illuminate our path.
speaker: Margaret
content: The road ahead of us... I'll illuminate our path.
